smoke_cancellation_reason: smoke yaml's `total_training_steps: 200` is only used by the LR scheduler (anneal target), not as a training cap. The trainer needs `max_train_steps: 200` to actually halt. Without it the smoke would have run 2 full epochs (~6.4 hr at observed 0.26 it/s on A100 us-east1). The bug was discovered AFTER smoke had already passed all gates at step 100/200 (ckpts saved). Continuing would have wasted ~$15 with zero info gain. Fix landed in both yaml files; full launch uses image 1.3.298 which contains the fix.
